name: Voyager
titleZh: Voyager：大模型驱动的开放式具身智能体
summary: An embodied Minecraft agent built from an automatic curriculum, a growing library of executable skills and iterative self-verification, running entirely on black-box GPT-4 calls.
summaryZh: 一个具身 Minecraft 智能体：自动课程表 + 持续增长的技能代码库 + 迭代自校验，全程只通过黑盒调用 GPT-4。
keyFact: Voyager (Wang et al., arXiv:2305.16291, 2023-05-25) reported 3.3× more unique items, 2.3× longer travel and up to 15.3× faster tech-tree progress than the prior state of the art, with no parameter fine-tuning.
keyFactZh: Voyager（Wang 等，arXiv:2305.16291，2023-05-25）报告称相比此前最优方案，取得 3.3 倍独特物品、2.3 倍行进距离、科技树推进最高快 15.3 倍，且完全没有微调模型参数。
whyItMatters: The durable idea is the skill library: executable code as reusable memory, which generalises well beyond Minecraft.
whyItMattersZh: 真正留下来的思路是「技能库」：把可执行代码当作可复用的记忆，这个做法远不局限于 Minecraft。
title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
